headline: Chargers Place QB Trey Lance, T Trevor Penning On IR; Activate Two From IR
summary: Attrition continues to provide hardship for the still winless Chargers. Los Angeles announced today that, while they were able to activate fullback/defensive tackle Scott Matlock and offensive lineman Branson Taylor from injured reserve, they will be taking the roster spots of quarterback Trey Lance and offensive tackle Trevor Penning, who are being placed on IR. headline: Ravens are much different with and without Lamar Jackson
summary: As expected, given that he's week-to-week with an ankle injury, Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson will miss Sunday night's game against the Falcons.

headline: Seahawks sign CB Trevon Diggs to their active roster
summary: Cornerback Trevon Diggs made his Seahawks debut last Sunday and he moved up to the active roster on a lasting basis Saturday.
